items.quote: My go-to handyperson, Andrea is knowledgable, professional and asks a fair price. She's helped me with plumbing, landscaping, light carpentry, light fixtures and other random jobs. She also explains clearly what she is doing and why. I recommend her highly for your home improvement projects!

Really appreciate working with Andrea on some kitchen carpentry and masonry jobs around our home, kept us informed throughout, was easy to schedule with, disclosed prices upfront and did a great job with her crew! Would recommend 100%.
Andrea did a great job pressure washing the little concrete slab behind my condo. She worked around my schedule and I felt the price was very fair.
